finding.claim: /fetch validates the hostname by resolving it with socket.getaddrinfo in is_safe_url. requests.get then resolves the hostname again independently. An attacker-controlled DNS server can return a public IP for the first lookup and an internal IP (127.0.0.1 or 169.254.169.254) for the second, which is a DNS-rebinding TOCTOU that bypasses the check. The response body prefix is returned to the attacker. Redirects are disabled, so redirects are not a bypass route.
